house.description: Sweet Potato Comfort Pie organization funding provided, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Legacy Finance

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for the organization Sweet Potato Comfort Pie.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; SWEET POTATO COMFORT PIE. +]

[+$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to Sweet Potato Comfort Pie for programming that celebrates traditional food and uses culinary arts, storytelling, and other creative forms of culture-sharing to celebrate and educate communities on culture and history. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for the organization Sweet Potato Comfort Pie.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SWEET POTATO COMFORT PIE.

$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to Sweet Potato Comfort Pie for programming that celebrates traditional food and uses culinary arts, storytelling, and other creative forms of culture-sharing to celebrate and educate communities on culture and history.
additions: $500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to Sweet Potato Comfort Pie for programming that celebrates traditional food and uses culinary arts, storytelling, and other creative forms of culture-sharing to celebrate and educate communities on culture and history.
